pages.text: The artisanal satchel employs an $(#AA00AA)Afrit$() to assist the summoner in drawing pentacles for their rituals. Unlike $(#AA00AA)Foliot$() in the apprentice satchel, the bound $(#AA00AA)Afrit$() can set up an entire pentacle within a moments notice.$(br2) Moreover, the $()
spirit can also clean up the pentacle after the ritual is complete, leaving no trace of the ritual behind.$(br)

pages.title: Already have ritual satchel?
pages.text: You can use this alternative recipe to upgrade the $(item)Apprentice Ritual Satchel$(), keeping the items inside!$(br)

pages.title: About
pages.text: A ritual satchel can hold items needed to create pentacles for rituals.$(br)An item with durability will be used until only 1 durability remains, which will stop the glint effect.$(br)Other items cannot be placed in the satchel.$()

pages.title: About
pages.text: $(br2)The satchel sets up an entire pentacle at once, if all necessary items are present in the satchel.$(br)It can also remove (intact) pentacles by $(#55FF55)Right-Clicking$() the $(item)Golden Sacrificial Bowl$() and store all blocks $()

pages.title: Usage (Drawing)
pages.text: 1. $(#55FF55)Shift-Right-Click$() to open the satchel and place chalks, candles, crystals, skulls and other items needed for rituals.$(br)2. Using this book, use the "eye" icon to preview the pentacle you want to set up in the world.$(br)3. $(#55FF55)Right-Click$() $()

pages.title: Usage (Drawing)
pages.text: with this book to anchor the preview pentacle in the spot where you want to set it up.$(br)4. $(#55FF55)Right-Click$() with the satchel on a previewed chalk mark or block to automatically place all previewed blocks, since have the materials inside.$()

pages.title: Usage (Cleaning)
pages.text: 1. Find a pentacle you want to remove. The pentacle needs to be intact (ready for a ritual).$(br)2. $(#55FF55)Right-Click$() the central $(item)Golden Sacrificial Bowl$() with the satchel.$(br)2. The satchel will remove all chalk marks, and pick up all $()

pages.title: Usage (Cleaning)
pages.text: paraphernalia blocks, such as candles or skulls, used in the pentacle.$(br)

pages.title: Chalk Brush
pages.text: The ritual satchel can also store your $(item)Chalk Brush$().$(br)The stored brush will be selected and used automatically when you $(#55FF55)Right-Click$() on chalk glyphs.$(br)
